name: boleto-display
description: Displays a Brazilian boleto bancário with barcode visualization, digitable line, and copy-to-clipboard functionality. UI-only — does not generate or validate boletos.

onCopyLine.description: Callback when digitable line is copied. Receives digits string.

behavior.clipboard: Copies raw digits on button click
behavior.barcodeVisualization: Generates visual barcode representation from digits

states.default: Displays boleto information with barcode and copy button
states.copied: Shows 'Copiado!' feedback for 2 seconds after copy

context.whenToUse: When displaying a boleto bancário for the user to copy and pay via their banking app
context.whenNotToUse: When you need to generate boletos — use a PSP API (Itaú, Bradesco, etc.) for generation
context.culturalNote: Boleto bancário is one of the most popular payment methods in Brazil, used by millions without credit cards. The digitable line (linha digitável) is what users paste into banking apps.
context.accessibility: Copy button is keyboard accessible. Barcode is decorative (aria-hidden).

doesNot: Communicate with banks or payment providers
requires: Backend integration with a bank or PSP to generate the digitableLine
Valid boleto data from your payment provider
